### Get transfer batch
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/get-payment-transfer-batch

> Retrieves a transfer batch with recipient rows and chunk transfer summaries.

`GET /v1/payments/transfer-batches/{batchId}`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `transfer_batches.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`batchId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `xbatch_example`

  Transfer batch identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Transfer batch details

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Transfer batch response payload.

    - **`batch`** · `object` · required

      Transfer batch details.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `xbatch_example`

        Transfer batch identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier for the transfer batch.

      - **`externalId`** · `string | null` · required · example `payroll_2026_06_30`

        Caller-provided batch correlation ID.

      - **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact source SDP Wallet ID, or null for unresolved legacy batches.

      - **`sourceProviderWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Source Provider wallet ID retained as evidence.

      - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source custody wallet address.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required · example `SOL`

        Token symbol or mint address.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `partially_failed`, `archived` · example `processing`

        Transfer batch status.

      - **`totalAmount`** · `string | null` · required · example `1000.00`

        Total requested batch amount in UI units, when computed.

      - **`recipientCount`** · `integer` · required · example `20`

        Number of recipient rows in the batch.

      - **`transactionCount`** · `integer` · required · example `1`

        Number of Solana transaction chunks for the batch.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`recipients`** · `object[]`

      Recipient rows for the batch, included on detail responses.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required

        Transfer batch recipient identifier.

      - **`batchId`** · `string` · required

        Parent transfer batch identifier.

      - **`transferId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

        Payment transfer chunk that settled this recipient, once assigned.

      - **`externalId`** · `string | null` · required · example `payroll_row_001`

        Caller-provided recipient correlation ID.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier for the recipient.

      - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account identifier for the recipient.

      - **`destination`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Resolved Solana destination address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `archived` · example `pending`

        Transfer batch recipient status.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required

        Recipient-level failure reason, when available. A recipient the source wallet could not fund reads "The wallet used for this payment does not have enough funds. Add funds and try again."

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`transfers`** · `object[]`

      Payment transfer chunk records associated with this batch.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

        Transfer identifier (SDP record ID, not the on-chain signature).

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`custodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact SDP Wallet ID associated with the persisted transfer, or null for unresolved legacy and observed rows.

      - **`providerWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID retained as evidence; not an execution selector.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier for the transfer.

      - **`type`** · `string` · required · example `transfer`

        Transfer type.

      - **`kind`** · `string` · required

        Dashboard transaction kind derived from the transfer type and originating Payments resource.

      - **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `inbound`, `outbound` · example `outbound`

        Transfer direction.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · example `confirmed`

        Transfer status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required · example `sig_example`

        Solana transaction signature (tx id/hash).

      - **`serializedTx`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `base64_tx_example`

        Base64-encoded transaction payload, if available. Always null for transfer batch chunks, whose signed bytes stay server-side.

      - **`slot`** · `integer | null` · required · example `123456`

        Slot number, if confirmed.

      - **`blockTime`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Block time, if confirmed.

      - **`confirmedAt`** · `string` · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        When SDP confirmed the transfer on chain.

      - **`fee`** · `integer | null` · required · example `0`

        Network fee the source wallet paid, in lamports: 0 when SDP sponsored the transaction, null when not known.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Signature failed`

        Error message if the transaction failed.

      - **`initiatedBy`** · `object`

        Initiator that triggered the transfer.

        - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `api_key`, `user`, `system` · example `api_key`

          Initiator type.

        - **`id`** · `string`

          Initiator identifier if applicable.

        - **`display`** · `string`

          Human-friendly label for the initiator.

      - **`source`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`destination`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Destination wallet address.

      - **`memo`** · `string` · max length 256

        Optional memo for the transfer.

      - **`token`** · `string`

        Token symbol or mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty tied to the transfer record, when available.

      - **`counterpartyDisplayName`** · `string` · example `Acme Studio`

        Current display name of the counterparty tied to the transfer.

      - **`risk`** · `object`

        Optional risk evaluation for the transfer.

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `trm`

          Risk scoring provider.

        - **`score`** · `string` · required · example `0.12`

          Provider-specific risk score.

        - **`level`** · `string` · required · one of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `unknown` · example `low`

          Risk level classification.

        - **`evaluatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

          Timestamp when risk was evaluated.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `transfer_batches.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/transfer-batches/xbatch_example' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/transfer-batches/xbatch_example", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests

r = requests.get("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/transfer-batches/xbatch_example",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

---

## Payments: Recurring payments

### Create recurring payment
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/create-payment-recurring-payment

> Creates an SDP-custody outbound recurring payment intent from a custody wallet to a counterparty crypto-wallet account.

`POST /v1/payments/recurring-payments`

This stores backend state only; activation and collection are added by follow-up endpoints.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · required

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Creates an SDP-custody outbound recurring payment intent. Activation and collection are added by follow-up endpoints.

- **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Exact SDP Wallet ID (`id` from `GET /v1/wallets`) that will fund the recurring payment. Provider `walletId`, wallet addresses, and the legacy `sourceWalletId` selector are not accepted.

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty receiving the recurring payment.

- **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpacct_example`

  Counterparty crypto_wallet account. It must contain Solana wallet details.

- **`token`** · `string` · required · example `EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v`

  Token mint address or well-known symbol. Must be a USD stablecoin (e.g. USDC) or a token issued in this project; native SOL is not supported.

- **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `25.00`

  Recurring payment amount in UI units.

- **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · max 8760 · example `720`

  Billing period length in hours.

- **`firstCollectionAt`** · `string` · format `date-time` · example `2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

  Optional first collection timestamp. Defaults to activation time when omitted.

- **`metadataUri`** · `string` · format `uri` · max length 128 · example `https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json`

  Optional plan metadata URI.

## Responses

- **`201`** Recurring payment created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Recurring payment response payload.

    - **`recurringPayment`** · `object` · required

      SDP-custody outbound recurring payment record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

        SDP recurring payment ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact source SDP Wallet ID, or null for unresolved legacy records.

      - **`sourceProviderWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Source Provider wallet ID retained as evidence.

      - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account ID.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Counterparty wallet owner address.

      - **`destinationTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Derived counterparty token account used for collection.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        SPL token mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`firstCollectionAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Requested first collection timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Next due collection timestamp.

      - **`planId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription ID.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`planCreatedAt`** · `string | null` · required

        On-chain plan createdAt value as an unsigned integer string.

      - **`planCreationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for plan creation.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for subscription authorization.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Recurring payment status.

      - **`pausedReason`** · `string | null` · required · one of `custody_policy_refused`, `failed_attempts`, `destination_unavailable` · example `null`

        Why SDP paused the recurring payment, set exactly while `status` is `paused`: `custody_policy_refused` when the custody provider's policy refused to sign a collection, `failed_attempts` when one due period failed 5 times, or `destination_unavailable` when its counterparty or account is archived or unavailable in the project. Resume requires an active recipient and clears the reason.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`tokenApproval`** · `object`

      Present when the recurring payment is canceled, on the cancel response and on get: what became of the token approval it relied on.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `revoked`, `kept`, `revoking` · example `kept`

        `revoked` once the approval has been revoked since the cancel. `kept` while other live recurring payments on the same wallet and token, in this or another project, still use it; `sharedWith` lists the ones in this project. It is revoked once the last of them ends. `revoking` when nothing else uses it but the revoke has not confirmed yet, for example while a collection that was already processing settles; the background sweep finishes it.

      - **`delegate`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        The approval's delegate: the Subscriptions program's authority for this wallet and token.

      - **`sharedWith`** · `object[]` · required

        The other live recurring payments in this project on the same wallet and token that keep the approval. Empty unless `status` is `kept`, and empty then when only recurring payments in other projects keep it.

        - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

          SDP recurring payment ID.

        - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

          Recurring payment status.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "sourceCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "counterpartyId": "cpty_example",
    "counterpartyAccountId": "cpacct_example",
    "token": "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v",
    "amount": "25.00",
    "periodHours": 720,
    "firstCollectionAt": "2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "metadataUri": "https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID(),
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "sourceCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "counterpartyId": "cpty_example",
    "counterpartyAccountId": "cpacct_example",
    "token": "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v",
    "amount": "25.00",
    "periodHours": 720,
    "firstCollectionAt": "2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "metadataUri": "https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())},
  json={
    "sourceCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "counterpartyId": "cpty_example",
    "counterpartyAccountId": "cpacct_example",
    "token": "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v",
    "amount": "25.00",
    "periodHours": 720,
    "firstCollectionAt": "2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "metadataUri": "https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json"
  })
```

```json tab="201"
      "planCreatedAt": "example",
      "planCreationSignature": "example",
      "subscriptionPda": "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112",

      "pausedReason": null,

      "updatedAt": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
```

### List recurring payments
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/list-payment-recurring-payments

> Lists SDP-custody outbound recurring payments for the authenticated organization or project scope.

`GET /v1/payments/recurring-payments`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Filter recurring payments by counterparty.

- **`status`** · `string` · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

  Recurring payment status.

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · default `1`

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20`

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Recurring payment list

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Recurring payment list response payload.

    - **`recurringPayments`** · `object[]` · required

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

        SDP recurring payment ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact source SDP Wallet ID, or null for unresolved legacy records.

      - **`sourceProviderWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Source Provider wallet ID retained as evidence.

      - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account ID.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Counterparty wallet owner address.

      - **`destinationTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Derived counterparty token account used for collection.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        SPL token mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`firstCollectionAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Requested first collection timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Next due collection timestamp.

      - **`planId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription ID.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`planCreatedAt`** · `string | null` · required

        On-chain plan createdAt value as an unsigned integer string.

      - **`planCreationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for plan creation.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for subscription authorization.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Recurring payment status.

      - **`pausedReason`** · `string | null` · required · one of `custody_policy_refused`, `failed_attempts`, `destination_unavailable` · example `null`

        Why SDP paused the recurring payment, set exactly while `status` is `paused`: `custody_policy_refused` when the custody provider's policy refused to sign a collection, `failed_attempts` when one due period failed 5 times, or `destination_unavailable` when its counterparty or account is archived or unavailable in the project. Resume requires an active recipient and clears the reason.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"

  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"

r = requests.get("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

### Update recurring payment
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/update-payment-recurring-payment

> Updates an SDP-custody recurring payment.

`PATCH /v1/payments/recurring-payments/{id}`

Pending records are updated directly. Active metadata and due-date edits are applied in place, while active term, source, destination, or token edits create a replacement Solana subscription, authorize it, cancel the old subscription, and then swap the recurring payment to the replacement records.

Requires an `Idempotency-Key`, because an edit can sign and broadcast a replacement subscription. A same-key retry of a completed edit replays its answer. A retry of an interrupted edit gets `409` `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT` with `Retry-After` until the attempt is stale, then resumes from the last step SDP recorded. If a step was sent but not yet recorded when the edit was interrupted, which is rare, the retry can fail or send that step again, so read the recurring payment with `GET` before editing it again.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prp_example`

  SDP recurring payment record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · required

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Updates a recurring payment. Pending payments are edited directly. Active metadata or due-date updates are applied in place, while active term/source/destination/token updates create and authorize a replacement subscription before canceling the old one.

- **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Optional exact replacement SDP Wallet ID (`id` from `GET /v1/wallets`). Provider `walletId`, wallet addresses, and the legacy `sourceWalletId` selector are not accepted. Active replacements require write access to both the old and new source wallets.

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Optional replacement counterparty. When provided, counterpartyAccountId is also required.

- **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cpacct_example`

  Optional replacement counterparty account. Without counterpartyId, this changes the account for the current counterparty.

- **`token`** · `string` · example `EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v`

  Optional replacement token. Must be a USD stablecoin (e.g. USDC) or a token issued in this project; native SOL is not supported.

- **`amount`** · `string` · example `25.00`

  Optional replacement amount in UI units.

- **`periodHours`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · max 8760 · example `720`

  Optional replacement billing period length in hours. Active term changes create a replacement on-chain subscription.

- **`firstCollectionAt`** · `string | null` · format `date-time` · example `2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

  Pending-only first collection timestamp. Use null to clear the pending first collection override.

- **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · format `date-time` · example `2099-02-01T00:00:00.000Z`

  Active-only next due timestamp. Use null to reset to the earliest eligible collection time.

- **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · format `uri` · max length 128 · example `https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json`

  Optional plan metadata URI. Use null to clear it. Active metadata-only edits update the existing on-chain plan in place.

## Responses

- **`200`** Recurring payment updated

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Recurring payment response payload.

    - **`recurringPayment`** · `object` · required

      SDP-custody outbound recurring payment record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

        SDP recurring payment ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact source SDP Wallet ID, or null for unresolved legacy records.

      - **`sourceProviderWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Source Provider wallet ID retained as evidence.

      - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account ID.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Counterparty wallet owner address.

      - **`destinationTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Derived counterparty token account used for collection.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        SPL token mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`firstCollectionAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Requested first collection timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Next due collection timestamp.

      - **`planId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription ID.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`planCreatedAt`** · `string | null` · required

        On-chain plan createdAt value as an unsigned integer string.

      - **`planCreationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for plan creation.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for subscription authorization.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Recurring payment status.

      - **`pausedReason`** · `string | null` · required · one of `custody_policy_refused`, `failed_attempts`, `destination_unavailable` · example `null`

        Why SDP paused the recurring payment, set exactly while `status` is `paused`: `custody_policy_refused` when the custody provider's policy refused to sign a collection, `failed_attempts` when one due period failed 5 times, or `destination_unavailable` when its counterparty or account is archived or unavailable in the project. Resume requires an active recipient and clears the reason.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`tokenApproval`** · `object`

      Present when the recurring payment is canceled, on the cancel response and on get: what became of the token approval it relied on.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `revoked`, `kept`, `revoking` · example `kept`

        `revoked` once the approval has been revoked since the cancel. `kept` while other live recurring payments on the same wallet and token, in this or another project, still use it; `sharedWith` lists the ones in this project. It is revoked once the last of them ends. `revoking` when nothing else uses it but the revoke has not confirmed yet, for example while a collection that was already processing settles; the background sweep finishes it.

      - **`delegate`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        The approval's delegate: the Subscriptions program's authority for this wallet and token.

      - **`sharedWith`** · `object[]` · required

        The other live recurring payments in this project on the same wallet and token that keep the approval. Empty unless `status` is `kept`, and empty then when only recurring payments in other projects keep it.

        - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

          SDP recurring payment ID.

        - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

          Recurring payment status.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X PATCH 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments/prp_example' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "sourceCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "counterpartyId": "cpty_example",
    "counterpartyAccountId": "cpacct_example",
    "token": "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v",
    "amount": "25.00",
    "periodHours": 720,
    "firstCollectionAt": "2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "nextCollectionDueAt": "2099-02-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "metadataUri": "https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments/prp_example", {
  method: "PATCH",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID(),
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "sourceCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "counterpartyId": "cpty_example",
    "counterpartyAccountId": "cpacct_example",
    "token": "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v",
    "amount": "25.00",
    "periodHours": 720,
    "firstCollectionAt": "2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "nextCollectionDueAt": "2099-02-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "metadataUri": "https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

r = requests.patch("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments/prp_example",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())},
  json={
    "sourceCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "counterpartyId": "cpty_example",
    "counterpartyAccountId": "cpacct_example",
    "token": "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v",
    "amount": "25.00",
    "periodHours": 720,
    "firstCollectionAt": "2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "nextCollectionDueAt": "2099-02-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "metadataUri": "https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json"
  })
```

```json tab="200"
      "updatedAt": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
    },
    "tokenApproval": {
      "status": "kept",
      "delegate": "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112",
      "sharedWith": [
        {
          "id": "prp_example",
          "status": "active"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example",
    "timestamp": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

```json tab="403"
    "code": "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS",
```

### Get recurring payment
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/get-payment-recurring-payment

> Retrieves an SDP-custody outbound recurring payment record.

`GET /v1/payments/recurring-payments/{id}`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prp_example`

  SDP recurring payment record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Recurring payment

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Recurring payment response payload.

    - **`recurringPayment`** · `object` · required

      SDP-custody outbound recurring payment record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

        SDP recurring payment ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact source SDP Wallet ID, or null for unresolved legacy records.

      - **`sourceProviderWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Source Provider wallet ID retained as evidence.

      - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account ID.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Counterparty wallet owner address.

      - **`destinationTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Derived counterparty token account used for collection.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        SPL token mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`firstCollectionAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Requested first collection timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Next due collection timestamp.

      - **`planId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription ID.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`planCreatedAt`** · `string | null` · required

        On-chain plan createdAt value as an unsigned integer string.

      - **`planCreationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for plan creation.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for subscription authorization.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Recurring payment status.

      - **`pausedReason`** · `string | null` · required · one of `custody_policy_refused`, `failed_attempts`, `destination_unavailable` · example `null`

        Why SDP paused the recurring payment, set exactly while `status` is `paused`: `custody_policy_refused` when the custody provider's policy refused to sign a collection, `failed_attempts` when one due period failed 5 times, or `destination_unavailable` when its counterparty or account is archived or unavailable in the project. Resume requires an active recipient and clears the reason.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`tokenApproval`** · `object`

      Present when the recurring payment is canceled, on the cancel response and on get: what became of the token approval it relied on.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `revoked`, `kept`, `revoking` · example `kept`

        `revoked` once the approval has been revoked since the cancel. `kept` while other live recurring payments on the same wallet and token, in this or another project, still use it; `sharedWith` lists the ones in this project. It is revoked once the last of them ends. `revoking` when nothing else uses it but the revoke has not confirmed yet, for example while a collection that was already processing settles; the background sweep finishes it.

      - **`delegate`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        The approval's delegate: the Subscriptions program's authority for this wallet and token.

      - **`sharedWith`** · `object[]` · required

        The other live recurring payments in this project on the same wallet and token that keep the approval. Empty unless `status` is `kept`, and empty then when only recurring payments in other projects keep it.

        - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

          SDP recurring payment ID.

        - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

          Recurring payment status.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments/prp_example' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments/prp_example", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"

  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

### Activate recurring payment
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/activate-payment-recurring-payment

> Activates a pending SDP-custody recurring payment by creating the Solana subscriptions plan, authorizing the subscription, and storing the resulting on-chain identifiers and signatures.

`POST /v1/payments/recurring-payments/{id}/activate`

Both the counterparty and its account must be active before a fresh activation; an unavailable recipient returns `404` before claiming the schedule or signing. Recovery can confirm saved transactions, but cannot sign a new step for an unavailable recipient.

The source wallet gives the Subscriptions program's authority for that token an approval of 0, and each collection approves exactly its own amount in the same transaction as the pull, so the token program's `Approve` instruction appears in activation and collection transactions. If your custody provider's wallet policy allowlists programs or instructions, allow `Approve` to that authority, or the provider refuses the collection and SDP pauses the recurring payment with `pausedReason` `custody_policy_refused`.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prp_example`

  SDP recurring payment record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · required

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Responses

- **`200`** Recurring payment activated

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Recurring payment response payload.

    - **`recurringPayment`** · `object` · required

      SDP-custody outbound recurring payment record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

        SDP recurring payment ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact source SDP Wallet ID, or null for unresolved legacy records.

      - **`sourceProviderWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Source Provider wallet ID retained as evidence.

      - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account ID.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Counterparty wallet owner address.

      - **`destinationTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Derived counterparty token account used for collection.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        SPL token mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`firstCollectionAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Requested first collection timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Next due collection timestamp.

      - **`planId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription ID.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`planCreatedAt`** · `string | null` · required

        On-chain plan createdAt value as an unsigned integer string.

      - **`planCreationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for plan creation.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for subscription authorization.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Recurring payment status.

      - **`pausedReason`** · `string | null` · required · one of `custody_policy_refused`, `failed_attempts`, `destination_unavailable` · example `null`

        Why SDP paused the recurring payment, set exactly while `status` is `paused`: `custody_policy_refused` when the custody provider's policy refused to sign a collection, `failed_attempts` when one due period failed 5 times, or `destination_unavailable` when its counterparty or account is archived or unavailable in the project. Resume requires an active recipient and clears the reason.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`tokenApproval`** · `object`

      Present when the recurring payment is canceled, on the cancel response and on get: what became of the token approval it relied on.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `revoked`, `kept`, `revoking` · example `kept`

          SDP recurring payment ID.

        - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

          Recurring payment status.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

### Cancel recurring payment
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/cancel-payment-recurring-payment

> Permanently stops an active or paused SDP-custody recurring payment by submitting the Solana subscriptions immediate cancellation, which ends its on-chain subscription at once rather than at the end of the billing period.

`POST /v1/payments/recurring-payments/{id}/cancel`

A canceled recurring payment never collects or resumes again.

Every recurring payment from one wallet in one token relies on one token approval. When no other live recurring payment uses it, it is revoked right after the cancel; otherwise it stays for the schedules that still use it. The response's `tokenApproval` says which: `revoked`, `kept` with the recurring payments still using it in `sharedWith`, or `revoking` while a collection that was already processing settles, after which the background sweep revokes it. `GET` returns the same `tokenApproval` for a canceled recurring payment.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prp_example`

  SDP recurring payment record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · required

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Responses

- **`200`** Recurring payment canceled

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Recurring payment response payload.

    - **`recurringPayment`** · `object` · required

      SDP-custody outbound recurring payment record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

        SDP recurring payment ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact source SDP Wallet ID, or null for unresolved legacy records.

      - **`sourceProviderWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Source Provider wallet ID retained as evidence.

      - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account ID.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Counterparty wallet owner address.

      - **`destinationTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Derived counterparty token account used for collection.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        SPL token mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`firstCollectionAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Requested first collection timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Next due collection timestamp.

      - **`planId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription ID.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`planCreatedAt`** · `string | null` · required

        On-chain plan createdAt value as an unsigned integer string.

      - **`planCreationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for plan creation.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for subscription authorization.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Recurring payment status.

      - **`pausedReason`** · `string | null` · required · one of `custody_policy_refused`, `failed_attempts`, `destination_unavailable` · example `null`

        Why SDP paused the recurring payment, set exactly while `status` is `paused`: `custody_policy_refused` when the custody provider's policy refused to sign a collection, `failed_attempts` when one due period failed 5 times, or `destination_unavailable` when its counterparty or account is archived or unavailable in the project. Resume requires an active recipient and clears the reason.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`tokenApproval`** · `object`

      Present when the recurring payment is canceled, on the cancel response and on get: what became of the token approval it relied on.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `revoked`, `kept`, `revoking` · example `kept`

        `revoked` once the approval has been revoked since the cancel. `kept` while other live recurring payments on the same wallet and token, in this or another project, still use it; `sharedWith` lists the ones in this project. It is revoked once the last of them ends. `revoking` when nothing else uses it but the revoke has not confirmed yet, for example while a collection that was already processing settles; the background sweep finishes it.

      - **`delegate`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        The approval's delegate: the Subscriptions program's authority for this wallet and token.

      - **`sharedWith`** · `object[]` · required

        The other live recurring payments in this project on the same wallet and token that keep the approval. Empty unless `status` is `kept`, and empty then when only recurring payments in other projects keep it.

        - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

          SDP recurring payment ID.

        - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

          Recurring payment status.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments/prp_example/cancel' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments/prp_example/cancel", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID()
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments/prp_example/cancel",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())})
```
