Error responses use the [standard error shape](/docs/reference/conventions/errors).

---

### Collect recurring payment
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/collect-payment-recurring-payment

> Manually starts a due active SDP-custody recurring payment collection, creating a linked payment transfer and collection attempt.

`POST /v1/payments/recurring-payments/{id}/collect`

Before a new collection, SDP requires an active counterparty and account in the schedule's project. If either is archived or unavailable, the schedule pauses with `pausedReason` `destination_unavailable` and the request returns `409` without signing. That `409`, and every later collect or resume while the recipient stays unavailable, tells the caller to cancel the schedule and create a new one. An earlier in-flight collection still recovers.

If submission cannot be confirmed immediately, a `200` response returns the same transfer as `processing` with its known signature; reconciliation settles it, and the next due time advances only after exact on-chain confirmation.

When the source wallet cannot cover the amount, the request returns `400` `TRANSACTION_FAILED`, and the failed collection attempt and its transfer record the same reason in `error`, so the collection history shows why.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prp_example`

  SDP recurring payment record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · required

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Responses

- **`200`** Recurring payment collection result

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Recurring payment collection response payload.

    - **`recurringPayment`** · `object` · required

      SDP-custody outbound recurring payment record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

        SDP recurring payment ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact source SDP Wallet ID, or null for unresolved legacy records.

      - **`sourceProviderWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Source Provider wallet ID retained as evidence.

      - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account ID.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Counterparty wallet owner address.

      - **`destinationTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Derived counterparty token account used for collection.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        SPL token mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`firstCollectionAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Requested first collection timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Next due collection timestamp.

      - **`planId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription ID.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`planCreatedAt`** · `string | null` · required

        On-chain plan createdAt value as an unsigned integer string.

      - **`planCreationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for plan creation.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for subscription authorization.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Recurring payment status.

      - **`pausedReason`** · `string | null` · required · one of `custody_policy_refused`, `failed_attempts`, `destination_unavailable` · example `null`

        Why SDP paused the recurring payment, set exactly while `status` is `paused`: `custody_policy_refused` when the custody provider's policy refused to sign a collection, `failed_attempts` when one due period failed 5 times, or `destination_unavailable` when its counterparty or account is archived or unavailable in the project. Resume requires an active recipient and clears the reason.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`collectionAttempt`** · `object` · required

      Recurring payment collection attempt record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psca_example`

        Collection attempt ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string` · required

        Subscription ID.

      - **`transferId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

        Payment transfer record ID when linked.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        Token mint or normalized token identifier.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`dueAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`attemptedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `skipped` · example `pending`

        Collection attempt status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana transaction signature.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `The wallet used for this payment does not have enough funds. Add funds and try again.`

        Why the collection failed, if it did. A source wallet that cannot cover the amount records the same text the collect request returned with `400 TRANSACTION_FAILED`.

      - **`metadata`** · `object` · required

        Provider/job metadata for the attempt.

        One of:

        - **source: "manual"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `manual`

        - **source: "automated"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `automated`

        - **source: "retry"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `retry`

          - **`initialSource`** · `string` · required · one of `manual`, `automated`

          - **`transferId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`error`** · `string` · required

          - **`retryAfterAt`** · `string` · required

        - **source: "linked_transfer"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `linked_transfer`

          - **`initialSource`** · `string` · required · one of `manual`, `automated`

          - **`transferId`** · `string` · required

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`transfer`** · `object` · required

      Transfer transaction record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

        Transfer identifier (SDP record ID, not the on-chain signature).

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`custodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact SDP Wallet ID associated with the persisted transfer, or null for unresolved legacy and observed rows.

      - **`providerWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID retained as evidence; not an execution selector.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier for the transfer.

      - **`type`** · `string` · required · example `transfer`

        Transfer type.

      - **`kind`** · `string` · required

        Dashboard transaction kind derived from the transfer type and originating Payments resource.

      - **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `inbound`, `outbound` · example `outbound`

        Transfer direction.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · example `confirmed`

        Transfer status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required · example `sig_example`

        Solana transaction signature (tx id/hash).

      - **`serializedTx`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `base64_tx_example`

        Base64-encoded transaction payload, if available. Always null for transfer batch chunks, whose signed bytes stay server-side.

      - **`slot`** · `integer | null` · required · example `123456`

        Slot number, if confirmed.

      - **`blockTime`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Block time, if confirmed.

      - **`confirmedAt`** · `string` · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        When SDP confirmed the transfer on chain.

      - **`fee`** · `integer | null` · required · example `0`

        Network fee the source wallet paid, in lamports: 0 when SDP sponsored the transaction, null when not known.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `Signature failed`

        Error message if the transaction failed.

      - **`initiatedBy`** · `object`

        Initiator that triggered the transfer.

        - **`type`** · `string` · required · one of `api_key`, `user`, `system` · example `api_key`

          Initiator type.

        - **`id`** · `string`

          Initiator identifier if applicable.

        - **`display`** · `string`

          Human-friendly label for the initiator.

      - **`source`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`destination`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Destination wallet address.

      - **`memo`** · `string` · max length 256

        Optional memo for the transfer.

      - **`token`** · `string`

        Token symbol or mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty tied to the transfer record, when available.

      - **`counterpartyDisplayName`** · `string` · example `Acme Studio`

        Current display name of the counterparty tied to the transfer.

      - **`risk`** · `object`

        Optional risk evaluation for the transfer.

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `trm`

          Risk scoring provider.

        - **`score`** · `string` · required · example `0.12`

          Provider-specific risk score.

        - **`level`** · `string` · required · one of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `unknown` · example `low`

          Risk level classification.

        - **`evaluatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

          Timestamp when risk was evaluated.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

```json tab="200"
{
  "data": {
    "recurringPayment": {
      "id": "prp_example",
      "organizationId": "org_example",
      "projectId": "prj_example",
      "sourceCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
      "sourceProviderWalletId": "privy_wallet_123",
      "sourceAddress": "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112",
      "counterpartyId": "cpty_example",
```

### Resume recurring payment
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/resume-payment-recurring-payment

> Resumes a paused SDP-custody recurring payment.

`POST /v1/payments/recurring-payments/{id}/resume`

SDP pauses a recurring payment when a due period fails 5 times, at once when the custody provider's policy refuses to sign a collection, or before a new collection when its counterparty or account is archived or unavailable.

Resume requires both recipient records to be active; while either is archived or unavailable it returns 409, telling the caller to cancel the schedule and create a new one. Its on-chain subscription is still in place, so nothing is signed: the recurring payment returns to active, the failure count starts again, and a due period that has already ended moves to the next one. A canceled recurring payment cannot be resumed.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prp_example`

  SDP recurring payment record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · required

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Responses

- **`200`** Recurring payment resumed

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Recurring payment response payload.

    - **`recurringPayment`** · `object` · required

      SDP-custody outbound recurring payment record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

        SDP recurring payment ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`sourceCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact source SDP Wallet ID, or null for unresolved legacy records.

      - **`sourceProviderWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Source Provider wallet ID retained as evidence.

      - **`sourceAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Source wallet address.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account ID.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Counterparty wallet owner address.

      - **`destinationTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Derived counterparty token account used for collection.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        SPL token mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`firstCollectionAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Requested first collection timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Next due collection timestamp.

      - **`planId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string | null` · required

        Linked SDP subscription ID.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`planCreatedAt`** · `string | null` · required

        On-chain plan createdAt value as an unsigned integer string.

      - **`planCreationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for plan creation.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana signature for subscription authorization.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Recurring payment status.

      - **`pausedReason`** · `string | null` · required · one of `custody_policy_refused`, `failed_attempts`, `destination_unavailable` · example `null`

        Why SDP paused the recurring payment, set exactly while `status` is `paused`: `custody_policy_refused` when the custody provider's policy refused to sign a collection, `failed_attempts` when one due period failed 5 times, or `destination_unavailable` when its counterparty or account is archived or unavailable in the project. Resume requires an active recipient and clears the reason.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`tokenApproval`** · `object`

      Present when the recurring payment is canceled, on the cancel response and on get: what became of the token approval it relied on.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `revoked`, `kept`, `revoking` · example `kept`

        `revoked` once the approval has been revoked since the cancel. `kept` while other live recurring payments on the same wallet and token, in this or another project, still use it; `sharedWith` lists the ones in this project. It is revoked once the last of them ends. `revoking` when nothing else uses it but the revoke has not confirmed yet, for example while a collection that was already processing settles; the background sweep finishes it.

      - **`delegate`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        The approval's delegate: the Subscriptions program's authority for this wallet and token.

      - **`sharedWith`** · `object[]` · required

        The other live recurring payments in this project on the same wallet and token that keep the approval. Empty unless `status` is `kept`, and empty then when only recurring payments in other projects keep it.

        - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `prp_example`

          SDP recurring payment ID.

        - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_activation`, `activating`, `active`, `updating`, `canceling`, `resuming`, `paused`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

          Recurring payment status.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments/prp_example/resume' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments/prp_example/resume", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID()
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/recurring-payments/prp_example/resume",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())})
```

### List recurring payment collection attempts
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/list-payment-recurring-payment-collection-attempts

> Lists every collection attempt a recurring payment has made over its whole history, newest first: its current subscription and every subscription an edit replaced.

`GET /v1/payments/recurring-payments/{id}/collection-attempts`

A recurring payment that has not been activated has none.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prp_example`

  SDP recurring payment record ID.

## Query parameters

- **`status`** · `string` · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `skipped` · example `pending`

  Collection attempt status.

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · default `1`

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20`

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Collection attempt list

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Collection attempt list response payload.

    - **`collectionAttempts`** · `object[]` · required

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psca_example`

        Collection attempt ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string` · required

        Subscription ID.

      - **`transferId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

        Payment transfer record ID when linked.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        Token mint or normalized token identifier.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`dueAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`attemptedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `skipped` · example `pending`

        Collection attempt status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana transaction signature.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `The wallet used for this payment does not have enough funds. Add funds and try again.`

        Why the collection failed, if it did. A source wallet that cannot cover the amount records the same text the collect request returned with `400 TRANSACTION_FAILED`.

      - **`metadata`** · `object` · required

        Provider/job metadata for the attempt.

        One of:

        - **source: "manual"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `manual`

        - **source: "automated"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `automated`

        - **source: "retry"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `retry`

          - **`initialSource`** · `string` · required · one of `manual`, `automated`

          - **`transferId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`error`** · `string` · required

          - **`retryAfterAt`** · `string` · required

        - **source: "linked_transfer"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `linked_transfer`

          - **`initialSource`** · `string` · required · one of `manual`, `automated`

          - **`transferId`** · `string` · required

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request


## Payments: Payment requests

### Create payment request
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/create-payment-request

> Creates a payment request: an amount of one token for a payer to send to a custody wallet in the caller's project, through the request's hosted payment link.

`POST /v1/payments/requests`

Requires `payment_requests.manage`. `walletId` is the provider wallet ID (`walletId` from `GET /v1/wallets`), not the SDP Wallet ID transfers take; an unknown wallet, or one outside the project, returns 404. `amount` is a decimal string with at most the mint's decimals, so `0.05` and `0.050` are the same request; more decimals return 400. A native SOL request is refused with 409 `AMOUNT_BELOW_RENT_MINIMUM` when the wallet has no account and the amount is below the rent-exempt minimum. The response is the only one besides `GET /v1/payments/requests/{paymentRequestId}/link` that carries `publicToken`. Accepts an Idempotency-Key: a retry with the same key and request returns the original payment request instead of creating a second one.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `payment_requests.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create payment request payload.

- **`walletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

  Receiving custody wallet in the caller's project. Provider wallet ID: the `walletId` field returned by GET /v1/wallets. The wallet record `id` and the public key are not accepted. An SDP Wallet ID (`cwlt_...`) returns 404.

- **`token`** · `string` · required · example `EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v`

  Mint address of the token to request. Symbols are not accepted; for native SOL, pass `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`.

- **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `10.00`

  Amount to request in UI units, as a decimal string greater than zero with no more decimal places than the mint has.

- **`expiresAt`** · `string | null` · format `date-time` · default `null` · example `2026-12-01T00:00:00.000Z`

  When the request stops accepting payment, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Null or omitted: it never expires.

## Responses

- **`201`** Payment request created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    A new payment request, with its link token.

    - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `preq_example`

      SDP payment request ID.

    - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required

      Organization ID.

    - **`projectId`** · `string | null` · required

      Project ID.

    - **`walletId`** · `string` · required

      Receiving custody wallet's provider ID.

    - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Address the payment is sent to.

    - **`token`** · `string` · required

      Token mint address.

    - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

      Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

    - **`reference`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Solana Pay reference account that identifies the payment on chain.

    - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `awaiting_payment`, `paid`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `canceled`

      Payment request status. `awaiting_payment` is open; `paid` was settled by an on-chain payment; `canceled` and `expired` closed without one.

    - **`expiresAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      Expiry, if any.

    - **`fulfilledByTransferId`** · `string | null` · required

      The inbound transfer that paid the request.

    - **`paidLate`** · `boolean` · required

      Whether the payment landed after the request expired or was canceled. A payer who signed before then can still pay.

    - **`lastCheckedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      When SDP last read the chain for the payment.

    - **`canceledByApiKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

      The API key that canceled the request; null when a member did, or it is not canceled.

    - **`canceledByUserId`** · `string | null` · required

      User ID of the member who canceled the request; null when an API key did, or it is not canceled.

    - **`canceledAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      When it was canceled.

    - **`lifecycle`** · `object[]` · required

      Every status the request entered, oldest first.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `awaiting_payment`, `paid`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `canceled`

        Payment request status. `awaiting_payment` is open; `paid` was settled by an on-chain payment; `canceled` and `expired` closed without one.

      - **`at`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

      User ID of the member, or of the API key's creator, who created it.

    - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`publicToken`** · `string` · required · example `example-public-token`

      Token behind the request's hosted payment link, `/pay/{publicToken}`. Anyone holding it can build the request's fee-sponsored payment transaction, so share it only with the payer. Reads never return it; get it again with `GET /v1/payments/requests/{paymentRequestId}/link`.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `payment_requests.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/requests' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "walletId": "privy_wallet_123",
    "token": "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v",
    "amount": "10.00",
    "expiresAt": null
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/requests", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID(),
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "walletId": "privy_wallet_123",
    "token": "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v",
    "amount": "10.00",
    "expiresAt": null
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/requests",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())},
  json={
    "walletId": "privy_wallet_123",
    "token": "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v",
    "amount": "10.00",
    "expiresAt": None
  })
```

## Example responses

```json tab="201"
{
  "data": {
    "id": "preq_example",
    "organizationId": "organization_example",
    "projectId": "project_example",
    "walletId": "wallet_example",
    "destinationAddress": "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112",
    "token": "example",
    "amount": "100.00",
    "reference": "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112",
    "status": "canceled",
    "expiresAt": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "fulfilledByTransferId": "fulfilledbytransfer_example",
    "paidLate": false,
    "lastCheckedAt": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "canceledByApiKeyId": "canceledbyapikey_example",
    "canceledByUserId": "canceledbyuser_example",
    "canceledAt": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "lifecycle": [
      {
        "status": "canceled",
        "at": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
      }
    ],
    "createdBy": "example",
    "createdAt": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "publicToken": "example-public-token"
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example",
    "timestamp": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

```json tab="403"
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS",
    "message": "Missing action: payment_requests.manage",
    "details": {
      "action": "payment_requests.manage"
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example"
  }
}
```

Error responses use the [standard error shape](/docs/reference/conventions/errors).

### List payment requests
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/list-payment-requests

> Lists the caller's project's payment requests, newest first.

`GET /v1/payments/requests`

Requires `payment_requests.read`. An open request past its `expiresAt` reads as `expired`. Records never carry `publicToken`.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `payment_requests.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · default `1` · example `1`

  Page number, starting at 1.

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20` · example `20`

  Results per page, 1 to 100.

- **`status`** · `string` · one of `awaiting_payment`, `paid`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `canceled`

  Payment request status. `awaiting_payment` is open; `paid` was settled by an on-chain payment; `canceled` and `expired` closed without one.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Payment request list

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Payment request list response payload.

    - **`paymentRequests`** · `object[]` · required

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `preq_example`

        SDP payment request ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required

        Organization ID.

      - **`projectId`** · `string | null` · required

        Project ID.

      - **`walletId`** · `string` · required

        Receiving custody wallet's provider ID.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Address the payment is sent to.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        Token mint address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`reference`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Solana Pay reference account that identifies the payment on chain.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `awaiting_payment`, `paid`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `canceled`

        Payment request status. `awaiting_payment` is open; `paid` was settled by an on-chain payment; `canceled` and `expired` closed without one.

      - **`expiresAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Expiry, if any.

      - **`fulfilledByTransferId`** · `string | null` · required

        The inbound transfer that paid the request.

      - **`paidLate`** · `boolean` · required

        Whether the payment landed after the request expired or was canceled. A payer who signed before then can still pay.

      - **`lastCheckedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        When SDP last read the chain for the payment.

      - **`canceledByApiKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

        The API key that canceled the request; null when a member did, or it is not canceled.

      - **`canceledByUserId`** · `string | null` · required

        User ID of the member who canceled the request; null when an API key did, or it is not canceled.

      - **`canceledAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        When it was canceled.

      - **`lifecycle`** · `object[]` · required

        Every status the request entered, oldest first.

        - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `awaiting_payment`, `paid`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `canceled`

          Payment request status. `awaiting_payment` is open; `paid` was settled by an on-chain payment; `canceled` and `expired` closed without one.

        - **`at`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

          ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        User ID of the member, or of the API key's creator, who created it.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `payment_requests.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

### Get payment request
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/get-payment-request

> Retrieves one payment request in the caller's project; another project's request returns 404.

`GET /v1/payments/requests/{paymentRequestId}`

Requires `payment_requests.read`. An open request past its `expiresAt` reads as `expired`. The record never carries `publicToken`; use `GET /v1/payments/requests/{paymentRequestId}/link`.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `payment_requests.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`paymentRequestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `preq_example`

  SDP payment request ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Payment request

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    A payment request. Reads never carry its link token.

    - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `preq_example`

      SDP payment request ID.

    - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required

      Organization ID.

    - **`projectId`** · `string | null` · required

      Project ID.

    - **`walletId`** · `string` · required

      Receiving custody wallet's provider ID.

    - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Address the payment is sent to.

    - **`token`** · `string` · required

      Token mint address.

    - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

      Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

    - **`reference`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Solana Pay reference account that identifies the payment on chain.

    - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `awaiting_payment`, `paid`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `canceled`

      Payment request status. `awaiting_payment` is open; `paid` was settled by an on-chain payment; `canceled` and `expired` closed without one.

    - **`expiresAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      Expiry, if any.

    - **`fulfilledByTransferId`** · `string | null` · required

      The inbound transfer that paid the request.

    - **`paidLate`** · `boolean` · required

      Whether the payment landed after the request expired or was canceled. A payer who signed before then can still pay.

    - **`lastCheckedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      When SDP last read the chain for the payment.

    - **`canceledByApiKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

      The API key that canceled the request; null when a member did, or it is not canceled.

    - **`canceledByUserId`** · `string | null` · required

      User ID of the member who canceled the request; null when an API key did, or it is not canceled.

    - **`canceledAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      When it was canceled.

    - **`lifecycle`** · `object[]` · required

      Every status the request entered, oldest first.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `awaiting_payment`, `paid`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `canceled`

        Payment request status. `awaiting_payment` is open; `paid` was settled by an on-chain payment; `canceled` and `expired` closed without one.

      - **`at`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

      User ID of the member, or of the API key's creator, who created it.

    - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `payment_requests.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

```json tab="403"
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS",
    "message": "Missing action: payment_requests.read",
    "details": {
      "action": "payment_requests.read"
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example"
  }
}
```

Error responses use the [standard error shape](/docs/reference/conventions/errors).

### Get payment request link
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/get-payment-request-link

> Returns the token behind a payment request's hosted payment link, /pay/{publicToken}.

`GET /v1/payments/requests/{paymentRequestId}/link`

Anyone holding it can build the request's fee-sponsored payment transaction, so this route requires `payment_requests.manage`, not `payment_requests.read`. Another project's request returns 404. The token is returned whatever the request's status.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `payment_requests.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`paymentRequestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `preq_example`

  SDP payment request ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Payment request link token

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    A payment request's link token.

    - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `preq_example`

      SDP payment request ID.

    - **`publicToken`** · `string` · required · example `example-public-token`

      Token behind the request's hosted payment link, `/pay/{publicToken}`. Anyone holding it can build the request's fee-sponsored payment transaction, so share it only with the payer. Reads never return it; get it again with `GET /v1/payments/requests/{paymentRequestId}/link`.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `payment_requests.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/requests/preq_example/link' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/requests/preq_example/link", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests

r = requests.get("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/requests/preq_example/link",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

## Example responses

```json tab="200"
{
  "data": {
    "id": "preq_example",
    "publicToken": "example-public-token"
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example",
    "timestamp": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

```json tab="403"
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS",
    "message": "Missing action: payment_requests.manage",
    "details": {
      "action": "payment_requests.manage"
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example"
  }
}
```

Error responses use the [standard error shape](/docs/reference/conventions/errors).

### Cancel payment request
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/cancel-payment-request

> Cancels an open payment request, so its payment link stops building and sponsoring transactions.

`POST /v1/payments/requests/{paymentRequestId}/cancel`

Requires `payment_requests.manage`. Canceling a request that is already canceled returns it unchanged. A paid or expired request returns 409, and so does one whose fee-sponsored transaction can still land: retry once that transaction's blockhash expires. A payer who signed before the cancel can still land the payment; SDP records it as paid, with `paidLate` set when it landed after the cancel.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `payment_requests.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`paymentRequestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `preq_example`

  SDP payment request ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Responses

- **`200`** Payment request canceled

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    A payment request. Reads never carry its link token.

    - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `preq_example`

      SDP payment request ID.

    - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required

      Organization ID.

    - **`projectId`** · `string | null` · required

      Project ID.

    - **`walletId`** · `string` · required

      Receiving custody wallet's provider ID.

    - **`destinationAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Address the payment is sent to.

    - **`token`** · `string` · required

      Token mint address.

    - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

      Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

    - **`reference`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Solana Pay reference account that identifies the payment on chain.

    - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `awaiting_payment`, `paid`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `canceled`

      Payment request status. `awaiting_payment` is open; `paid` was settled by an on-chain payment; `canceled` and `expired` closed without one.

    - **`expiresAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      Expiry, if any.

    - **`fulfilledByTransferId`** · `string | null` · required

      The inbound transfer that paid the request.

    - **`paidLate`** · `boolean` · required

      Whether the payment landed after the request expired or was canceled. A payer who signed before then can still pay.

    - **`lastCheckedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      When SDP last read the chain for the payment.

    - **`canceledByApiKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

      The API key that canceled the request; null when a member did, or it is not canceled.

    - **`canceledByUserId`** · `string | null` · required

      User ID of the member who canceled the request; null when an API key did, or it is not canceled.

    - **`canceledAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      When it was canceled.

    - **`lifecycle`** · `object[]` · required

      Every status the request entered, oldest first.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `awaiting_payment`, `paid`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `canceled`

        Payment request status. `awaiting_payment` is open; `paid` was settled by an on-chain payment; `canceled` and `expired` closed without one.

      - **`at`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

      User ID of the member, or of the API key's creator, who created it.

    - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `payment_requests.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/requests/preq_example/cancel' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/requests/preq_example/cancel", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID()
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/requests/preq_example/cancel",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())})
```

```json tab="200"
    "token": "example",
    "amount": "100.00",

    "paidLate": false,
    "lastCheckedAt": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "canceledByApiKeyId": "canceledbyapikey_example",
    "canceledByUserId": "canceledbyuser_example",
    "canceledAt": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "lifecycle": [
      {
        "status": "canceled",
        "at": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
```

## Counterparties

### Counterparties
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties

> A counterparty is a person or business you pay or get paid by. You save their details and payment accounts once, then reuse them in payments.

## Profiles

| Method | Endpoint | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/counterparties/metadata` | [Get counterparty field options](/docs/reference/api/counterparties/get-counterparty-field-options.md) |
| `GET` | `/v1/counterparties` | [List counterparties](/docs/reference/api/counterparties/list-counterparties.md) |
| `POST` | `/v1/counterparties` | [Create counterparty](/docs/reference/api/counterparties/create-counterparty.md) |
| `GET` | `/v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}` | [Get counterparty](/docs/reference/api/counterparties/get-counterparty.md) |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}` | [Update counterparty](/docs/reference/api/counterparties/update-counterparty.md) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}` | [Archive counterparty](/docs/reference/api/counterparties/archive-counterparty.md) |

## Accounts

| Method | Endpoint | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts` | [List counterparty accounts](/docs/reference/api/counterparties/list-counterparty-accounts.md) |
| `POST` | `/v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts` | [Create counterparty account](/docs/reference/api/counterparties/create-counterparty-account.md) |
| `GET` | `/v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts/{counterpartyAccountId}` | [Get counterparty account](/docs/reference/api/counterparties/get-counterparty-account.md) |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts/{counterpartyAccountId}` | [Update counterparty account](/docs/reference/api/counterparties/update-counterparty-account.md) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts/{counterpartyAccountId}` | [Archive counterparty account](/docs/reference/api/counterparties/archive-counterparty-account.md) |

## Counterparties: Profiles

### Get counterparty field options
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/get-counterparty-field-options

> Returns the enum option sets and country list needed to build a counterparty form.

`GET /v1/counterparties/metadata`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.read` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Counterparty field options

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Field option sets for building a counterparty form: closed enums plus the country list.

    - **`fields`** · `object` · required

      - **`entityTypes`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `individual`, `business`

      - **`countries`** · `object[]` · required

        - **`code`** · `string` · required · example `US`

          ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

        - **`name`** · `string` · required · example `United States`

          English display name.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

### List counterparties
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/list-counterparties

> Lists counterparties for the authenticated organization.

`GET /v1/counterparties`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · default `1` · example `1`

  Page number (1-based).

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20` · example `20`

  Items per page (max 100).

- **`includeArchived`** · `boolean` · example `false`

  Include archived counterparties in results.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Counterparties list

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Paginated list of counterparties.

    - **`counterparties`** · `object[]` · required

      Counterparties.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project scope when the counterparty is project-scoped.

      - **`externalId`** · `string | null` · required · example `customer_42`

        Caller-supplied opaque identifier for cross-system reference. Do not place personal data in this indexed field.

      - **`entityType`** · `string` · required · one of `individual`, `business` · example `individual`

        Counterparty entity type.

      - **`displayName`** · `string` · required · example `Jane Doe`

        Human-readable, searchable display name. Keep it minimal because this indexed field is not application-encrypted.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `usr_example`

        User who created the counterparty. Null when created via API key.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · example `42`

      Total counterparties matching the query.

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `1`

      Current page number.

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `20`

      Items per page.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

```bash tab="cURL"

  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```
