### Create counterparty
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/create-counterparty

> Creates a counterparty.

`POST /v1/counterparties`

If externalId is provided, it must be unique within the organization.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create counterparty request body.

- **`externalId`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256 · example `customer_42`

  Caller-supplied opaque identifier for cross-system reference. Do not place personal data in this indexed field.

- **`entityType`** · `string` · required · one of `individual`, `business` · example `individual`

  Counterparty entity type.

- **`displayName`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 512 · example `Jane Doe`

  Human-readable, searchable display name. Keep it minimal because this indexed field is not application-encrypted.

## Responses

- **`201`** Counterparty created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Counterparty response payload.

    - **`counterparty`** · `object` · required

      Counterparty record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project scope when the counterparty is project-scoped.

      - **`externalId`** · `string | null` · required · example `customer_42`

        Caller-supplied opaque identifier for cross-system reference. Do not place personal data in this indexed field.

      - **`entityType`** · `string` · required · one of `individual`, `business` · example `individual`

        Counterparty entity type.

      - **`displayName`** · `string` · required · example `Jane Doe`

        Human-readable, searchable display name. Keep it minimal because this indexed field is not application-encrypted.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `usr_example`

        User who created the counterparty. Null when created via API key.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "externalId": "customer_42",
    "entityType": "individual",
    "displayName": "Jane Doe"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID(),
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "externalId": "customer_42",
    "entityType": "individual",
    "displayName": "Jane Doe"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())},
  json={
    "externalId": "customer_42",
    "entityType": "individual",
    "displayName": "Jane Doe"
  })
```

## Example responses

```json tab="201"
{
  "data": {
    "counterparty": {
      "id": "cpty_example",
      "organizationId": "org_example",
      "projectId": "prj_example",
      "externalId": "customer_42",
      "entityType": "individual",
      "displayName": "Jane Doe",
      "status": "active",
      "createdBy": "usr_example",
      "createdAt": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z"
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example",
    "timestamp": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

```json tab="403"
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS",
    "message": "Missing action: counterparties.manage",
    "details": {
      "action": "counterparties.manage"
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example"
  }
}
```

Error responses use the [standard error shape](/docs/reference/conventions/errors).

        User who created the counterparty. Null when created via API key.

### Update counterparty
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/update-counterparty

> Updates counterparty attributes.

`PATCH /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}`

At least one field must be provided. Use null on externalId to clear it.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Update counterparty request body. At least one field must be provided.

- **`externalId`** · `string | null` · min length 1 · max length 256 · example `customer_42`

  Updated opaque external ID. Do not include personal data. Use null to clear.

- **`entityType`** · `string` · one of `individual`, `business` · example `business`

  Updated counterparty entity type.

- **`displayName`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 512 · example `Jane Q. Doe`

  Updated searchable display name. Keep it minimal.

## Responses

- **`200`** Counterparty updated

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Counterparty response payload.

    - **`counterparty`** · `object` · required

      Counterparty record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project scope when the counterparty is project-scoped.

      - **`externalId`** · `string | null` · required · example `customer_42`

        Caller-supplied opaque identifier for cross-system reference. Do not place personal data in this indexed field.

      - **`entityType`** · `string` · required · one of `individual`, `business` · example `individual`

        Counterparty entity type.

      - **`displayName`** · `string` · required · example `Jane Doe`

        Human-readable, searchable display name. Keep it minimal because this indexed field is not application-encrypted.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `usr_example`

        User who created the counterparty. Null when created via API key.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

### Archive counterparty
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/archive-counterparty

> Archives a counterparty and its active accounts and provider links atomically.

`DELETE /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}`

Archived counterparties are hidden from default lists. New transfers and batches cannot use those accounts. Recurring payments pause before their next new collection; work already in flight keeps its recovery path.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Responses

- **`204`** Counterparty archived

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X DELETE 'https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID()
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

r = requests.delete("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())})
```

## Example responses

```json tab="403"
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS",
    "message": "Missing action: counterparties.manage",
    "details": {
      "action": "counterparties.manage"
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example"
  }
}
```

Error responses use the [standard error shape](/docs/reference/conventions/errors).

## Counterparties: Accounts

### List counterparty accounts
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/list-counterparty-accounts

> Lists payment accounts for a counterparty.

`GET /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts`

Crypto-wallet accounts can be used by payment flows that send funds to a counterparty wallet.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

## Query parameters

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · default `1` · example `1`

  Page number (1-based).

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20` · example `20`

  Items per page (max 100).

- **`includeArchived`** · `boolean` · example `false`

  Include archived counterparty accounts in results.

- **`accountKind`** · `string` · always `crypto_wallet` · example `crypto_wallet`

  Filter accounts by account kind.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Counterparty account list

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Paginated list of counterparty accounts.

    - **`accounts`** · `object[]` · required

      Counterparty accounts.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier.

      - **`accountKind`** · `string` · required · always `crypto_wallet` · example `crypto_wallet`

        Counterparty account kind.

      - **`label`** · `string | null` · required · example `USDC wallet`

        Optional human-readable account label.

      - **`details`** · `object` · required

        Account details. For crypto_wallet accounts, include network: "solana" and address as a Solana wallet address.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`providerAccountData`** · `object` · required

        Provider-specific account metadata preserved by SDP.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty account status.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · example `2`

      Total counterparty accounts matching the query.

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `1`

      Current page number.

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `20`

      Items per page.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl 'https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests

r = requests.get("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

### Create counterparty account
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/create-counterparty-account

> Creates a payment account for a counterparty.

`POST /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts`

For accountKind "crypto_wallet", details.network must be "solana" and details.address must be a Solana wallet address. A counterparty holds one active account per network and address: an address already on one of its active accounts answers 409 `CONFLICT` ("This address is already on this counterparty"). An archived account does not count, so re-adding its address creates a new account.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create counterparty account request body.

- **`accountKind`** · `string` · required · always `crypto_wallet` · example `crypto_wallet`

  Counterparty account kind.

- **`label`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256 · example `USDC wallet`

  Optional account label.

- **`details`** · `object`

  For crypto_wallet accounts, must include network: "solana" and address as a Solana wallet address.

  - **`*`** · `any`

- **`providerAccountData`** · `object`

  Provider-specific metadata to preserve with the account.

  - **`*`** · `any`

## Responses

- **`201`** Counterparty account created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Counterparty account response payload.

    - **`account`** · `object` · required

      Counterparty payment account record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier.

      - **`accountKind`** · `string` · required · always `crypto_wallet` · example `crypto_wallet`

        Counterparty account kind.

      - **`label`** · `string | null` · required · example `USDC wallet`

        Optional human-readable account label.

      - **`details`** · `object` · required

        Account details. For crypto_wallet accounts, include network: "solana" and address as a Solana wallet address.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`providerAccountData`** · `object` · required

        Provider-specific account metadata preserved by SDP.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty account status.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "accountKind": "crypto_wallet",
    "label": "USDC wallet",
    "details": {
      "network": "solana",
      "address": "7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU"
    },
    "providerAccountData": {}
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID(),
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "accountKind": "crypto_wallet",
    "label": "USDC wallet",
    "details": {
      "network": "solana",
      "address": "7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU"
    },
    "providerAccountData": {}
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())},
  json={
    "accountKind": "crypto_wallet",
    "label": "USDC wallet",
    "details": {
      "network": "solana",
      "address": "7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU"
    },
    "providerAccountData": {}
  })
```

## Example responses

```json tab="201"
{
  "data": {
    "account": {
      "id": "cpacct_example",
      "organizationId": "org_example",
      "projectId": "prj_example",
      "counterpartyId": "cpty_example",
      "accountKind": "crypto_wallet",
      "label": "USDC wallet",
      "details": {
        "network": "solana",
        "address": "7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU"
      },
      "providerAccountData": {},
      "status": "active",
      "createdAt": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z"
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example",
    "timestamp": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

```json tab="403"
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS",
    "message": "Missing action: counterparties.execute",
    "details": {
      "action": "counterparties.execute"
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example"
  }
}
```

Error responses use the [standard error shape](/docs/reference/conventions/errors).

### Update counterparty account
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/update-counterparty-account

> Updates a counterparty payment account.

`PATCH /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts/{counterpartyAccountId}`

At least one field must be provided. Changing details to an address already on another of the counterparty's active accounts answers 409 `CONFLICT`.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

- **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpacct_example`

  Counterparty account identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Update counterparty account request body. At least one field must be provided.

- **`label`** · `string | null` · min length 1 · max length 256 · example `Primary USDC wallet`

  Updated account label. Use null to clear.

- **`details`** · `object`

  Updated account details. Crypto-wallet accounts must retain network: "solana" and a valid Solana wallet address.

  - **`*`** · `any`

- **`providerAccountData`** · `object`

  Updated provider-specific metadata.

  - **`*`** · `any`

## Responses

- **`200`** Counterparty account updated

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Counterparty account response payload.

    - **`account`** · `object` · required

      Counterparty payment account record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier.

      - **`accountKind`** · `string` · required · always `crypto_wallet` · example `crypto_wallet`

        Counterparty account kind.

      - **`label`** · `string | null` · required · example `USDC wallet`

        Optional human-readable account label.

      - **`details`** · `object` · required

        Account details. For crypto_wallet accounts, include network: "solana" and address as a Solana wallet address.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`providerAccountData`** · `object` · required

        Provider-specific account metadata preserved by SDP.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty account status.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

### Archive counterparty account
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/archive-counterparty-account

> Archives a counterparty payment account.

`DELETE /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts/{counterpartyAccountId}`

Archived accounts are hidden from default lists.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

- **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpacct_example`

  Counterparty account identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Responses

- **`204`** Counterparty account archived

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X DELETE 'https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts/cpacct_example' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts/cpacct_example", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID()
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

r = requests.delete("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts/cpacct_example",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())})
```

## Example responses

```json tab="403"
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS",
    "message": "Missing action: counterparties.manage",
    "details": {
      "action": "counterparties.manage"
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example"
  }
}
```

Error responses use the [standard error shape](/docs/reference/conventions/errors).

## Getting Started

### Set up your workspace
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/guides/setup-organization

> Create your account and organization, which comes with a Sandbox and a Production project.

Everything you do in SDP belongs to an **organization**, your team's workspace. An organization holds **projects**, and each project has its own API keys, wallets, and members. This guide creates your account and organization.

### 1. Create your account

Go to [platform.solana.com](https://platform.solana.com) and click **Create account**. The sign-in screen has the same button at the top right. When sign-up is closed, these buttons read **Join the waitlist** and **Request access** instead.

Enter your email address and a password to create your account.

### 2. Create your organization

After you sign in, **Name your organization** asks for an **Organization name**. Enter it and click **Create organization**. You become the organization's admin. If you've been invited to an organization, accept the invitation or pick the organization from the list instead.

To switch organizations or projects later, click your organization's name at the top of the sidebar.

<img src="/docs/images/getting-started/org-switcher.png" alt="Organization switcher with your organizations, the project list and the organization ID" width="262" height="322" style={{ display: "block", maxWidth: "100%", height: "auto" }} />

### 3. Work in a project

Your organization comes with two projects: **Default Sandbox Project** on devnet and **Default Production Project** on mainnet. Build in the sandbox project. Production can't move money until SDP approves your organization; see [Go to mainnet](/docs/guides/go-to-mainnet). To read projects with an API key, see the [Projects API reference](/docs/reference/api/projects).

### 4. Next steps

- [Set up wallets](/docs/guides/setup-wallets) for signing transactions
- [Create API keys](/docs/developing-with-sdp/manage-api-keys) for programmatic access
- [Send your first payment](/docs/payments/send-basic-payment)
- [Go to mainnet](/docs/guides/go-to-mainnet) when your sandbox integration is ready

---

### Create a wallet
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/guides/setup-wallets

> Set up a custody provider and create wallets for signing transactions.

A **custody wallet** is a Solana keypair whose key a custody provider holds. SDP sends each signing request to the provider that holds the wallet's key. Set up a provider, then create wallets for transfers and other onchain operations.

## Supported providers

| Provider | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Privy** | Embedded wallet infrastructure platform |

<Tabs items={["Dashboard", "API"]}>
<Tab value="Dashboard">

### 1. Open wallet setup

Open **Wallets** in the sidebar and click **Create wallet**. Once the project has wallets, the button reads **Create a wallet**. Only organization admins can create wallets. Complete [organization setup](/docs/guides/setup-organization) first if needed.

### 2. Choose a custody provider

Under **Which provider holds the keys?**, select a provider. You can't change it after the wallet exists. When your project can use only one provider, it's already selected and the question isn't shown.

### 3. Choose whose account holds the keys

If you can connect your own account for the provider, the page asks whose account holds the keys, such as **Whose Privy account holds the keys?** When there's a choice, nothing is preselected.

- **SDP's Privy account**: for trying SDP out in Sandbox. It has no wallet policy and nothing to set up.
- **Your own Privy account**: connect it with its app ID and secret. Production accepts only your own account; see [Go to mainnet](/docs/guides/go-to-mainnet).

### 4. Create the first wallet

With SDP's account, enter a **Wallet label** and click **Create wallet**. The wallet's page opens with its address and balance.

With your own account, keep or rename the **Credential label**, and enter your **Privy app ID** and **Privy app secret**. Under **Wallet details**, enter a **Wallet label**. Click **Connect and create wallet**: SDP checks the credentials with Privy, then creates the wallet, which appears on **Wallets**.

![Privy provider setup with example credentials and a masked secret](/images/go-to-mainnet/04-connect-privy.png)

The first wallet in a provider account is a transfer wallet.

### 5. Create more wallets

On **Wallets**, click **Create a wallet** and select the provider if asked. The account question lists SDP's account where it's offered, each of your connections, and **Connect another Privy account**. A connection that isn't ready shows what it needs, with a link to fix it.

For SDP's account or an existing connection, enter a **Wallet label**, pick a **Purpose** (it starts on **Transfers**), and click **Create wallet**. **Connect another Privy account** works as in step 4.

A connection signs only with its current credentials. If you rotate or remove them while a request is signing, that request returns `409 CONFLICT` with `details.reason` set to `runtime_execution_unavailable`. Retry it as [Idempotency](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency) describes for that operation. A transfer that recorded the failure replays it under the same `Idempotency-Key`, so send the transfer again with a new key.

</Tab>
<Tab value="API">

#### 1. Set up the provider in the dashboard

Setting up a custody provider takes `wallets.configure`, and no API key can hold a `configure` action. An organization admin sets it up once per project, signed in to the dashboard (see the **Dashboard** tab), which calls `POST /v1/wallets/initialize` with that session. The same call with an API key returns `403 INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS` with `details.action` set to `wallets.configure`.

Production projects take only your own provider account. `POST /v1/wallets/initialize` sets up SDP's account of the provider (Managed custody), so in a Production project it returns `403` with `details.reason` set to `custody_mode_not_allowed`. Connect your own account to the project in the dashboard instead. Then create wallets in that connection with `connectionId`, using an API key that holds `wallets.manage`:

```bash title="Terminal"
export IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=$(uuidgen)

curl -X POST https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sf_..." \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $IDEMPOTENCY_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "connectionId": "cconn_123",
    "label": "Treasury wallet"
  }'
```

#### 2. Create more wallets

Every wallet names the provider account it lives under: `provider` for SDP's account of that provider (Managed), or `connectionId` for a connection your project added. Send exactly one of them; a body with both or neither returns `400`. There is no default account to fall back to.

<Tabs items={["curl", "TypeScript", "Java"]}>
<Tab value="curl">
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "provider": "privy",
    "label": "Treasury wallet",
    "purpose": "transfer"
  }'
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="TypeScript">
```typescript
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID(),
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "provider": "privy",
    "label": "Treasury wallet",
    "purpose": "transfer"
  })
});
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="Java">
```java title="CreateWallet.java"
String idempotencyKey = java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString();
HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder()
    .uri(URI.create("https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets"))
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer sf_...")
    .header("Idempotency-Key", idempotencyKey)
    .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString("""
        {
          "provider": "privy",
          "label": "Treasury wallet",
          "purpose": "transfer"
        }"""))
    .build();
```
</Tab>
</Tabs>

`purpose` is optional and defaults to `transfer`. Only a `transfer` wallet can be the source of a transfer, transfer batch, or recurring payment; any other purpose is refused with `403` and `details.reason` set to `wallet_purpose`. Reuse the same `Idempotency-Key` when you retry a wallet creation.

#### 3. List wallets

<Tabs items={["curl", "TypeScript", "Java"]}>
<Tab value="curl">
```bash title="Terminal"
curl "https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets?view=summary" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sf_..."
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="TypeScript">
```typescript title="list-wallets.ts"
const response = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets?view=summary", {
  headers: { "Authorization": "Bearer sf_..." },
});
const { data } = await response.json();
// data.wallets includes id, walletId, publicKey, provider, label, purpose, and status
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="Java">
```java title="ListWallets.java"
HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder()
    .uri(URI.create("https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets?view=summary"))
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer sf_...")
    .GET()
    .build();
```
</Tab>
</Tabs>

Every operation that signs names its wallet; there is no default wallet. Transfers take the wallet's `id` (`cwlt_…`) as `sourceCustodyWalletId`, and other modules' pages name their field. An API key limited to selected wallets lists the same `id` in `walletIds`.

```typescript title="transfer-request.ts"
const body = {
  sourceCustodyWalletId: "cwlt_123", // `id` from GET /v1/wallets
  destination: "7xKXz...9fGh",
  token: "9aBCd...4eEf",
  amount: "100.00",
};
```

</Tab>
</Tabs>
